items.work: String Quartet No. 2 in D major; Piano Quintet in C minor
items.performers: Goldner String Quartet; Piers Lane, piano
items.label: Hyperion, CDA68166
items.note: The Second Quartet runs 27:51 on Hyperion’s disc, which also holds the Piano Quintet and a Cello Sonata in B minor. The label’s 3:01 trailer carries extracts from the quartet’s Scherzo and from the quintet and the sonata.

items.work: Symphony No. 2 in B minor; Petite Suite (orchestrated Glazunov); Polovtsian Dances, orchestral version
items.performers: Royal Stockholm Philharmonic Orchestra; Gennady Rozhdestvensky
items.recorded: 30–31 March 1993 and 18 March 1994, Concert Hall, Stockholm
items.label: Chandos, CHAN 9386
items.note: Chandos lists the Second Symphony at 29:43 and the Petite Suite at 29:55. The Polovtsian Dances run to 15:07 in eight numbers, from a Presto at the start to an Allegro con spirito at the end.
